en: Black-and-white landscape view of a small village nestled in a valley surrounded by dense forested hills. The foreground shows scattered houses, barns, and farm buildings with pitched roofs, arranged along a narrow road. In the midground there is open pastureland with rows of trees and a few larger buildings, one resembling a church or chapel. The background is dominated by continuous evergreen-covered hills under a cloudy sky. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.
